remarks: Stunning multi-level home conveniently located in Lovely Lewiston, attractive curb appeal and prominently located on a private lot surrounded by plush greenery. Walk or drive to the Village of Lewiston for an enjoyable day of shopping, dining, festivals or simply take a seat by the River! 4 spacious bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, 2 wood-burning fireplaces, primary bedroom has ensuite full bathroom and 2 separate closets. The eat-in kitchen is a great space with stainless steel appliances including a high end electric range with a convection oven, Corian countertops, ample cupboards & overlooking the beautiful backyard where you can really enjoy nature. Large formal dining room, open to both the kitchen and living room, is great for entertaining. The living room is a good size, adorned with a stone fireplace and has an adjoining room that would be a perfect space for a home office, gym or a playroom. This home would present well for multigenerational living as well, with a family room, eating nook and second kitchen being located on the lower entry level. There's a full basement and 2 car, attached garage. So many possibilities!
